item: Black screen at the end of an online game (opponent surrendered or left mid-game; sometimes after my own surrender). Angle: server + protocol and the client/server contract at game end.
summary: I traced the whole end of a game: the server's order of messages, room disposal, the result and rating write, and how the app consumes them. The server cannot put a blank screen up by itself. It sends events with gameOver, then solution, then closes the room after 60 s. The results come from the in-memory session, never from an HTTP fetch, and the game ids are the same everywhere. So none of the suspected races applies: a 404 on /history, results lost before the client reads them, the client leaving before its results, or an id mismatch. The strongest lead is a correlation, not a confirmed cause. Every end that is not a full board opens the results with 0 ms delay, synchronously inside the Colyseus onMessage callback of the 'events' frame. The board-complete end, the one that works on the phone, waits 1.1 s on a timer. That fits all three reports: the opponent's surrender is always synchronous, my own surrender is synchronous only when the server's answer lands after the dialog has exited ("sometimes"), and "לתוצאות" (to results) after an abandonment comes from a button press. Real contract gaps were also found. A finished room auto-disposes about 1 s after the last connected client is gone. A drop after the end holds no seat. A player who was away when the game ended (screen off, background) and returns after their 16 s window finds no room, gets lostConnection with a stale state, and never sees the result. Nothing tells the client when the result and ratings are stored. There is also no diagnostic trail: in release builds the host log lines are dropped, and a hung JS thread is never reported to Crashlytics.

rootCauses.cause: Online results are opened synchronously inside the server's 'events' message callback (0 ms hold for every end except a full board), immediately followed by the 'solution' frame re-emitting into the game screen being replaced. This is the only end path that navigates from inside the WebSocket callback. Practice ends wait for the dialog's onExited, the board-complete end waits 1.1 s, and 'לתוצאות' is a press. That matches 'opponent surrendered → black' (always) and 'I surrendered → sometimes' (only when gameOver arrives after the dialog's onExited, so waits===0 → open() runs synchronously). The mechanism on the device is not proven (no repro, no crash reported); bug 9 had the same symptom on a 0-delay end.
rootCauses.evidence: apps/mobile/src/screens/game/model.ts:101-104 (endDelayMs returns 0 unless boardComplete); GameScreen.tsx:739-749 ('ended' → showResults(e.gameId, endDelayMs)); GameScreen.tsx:536-565 (waits===0 → open() at once, line 562) → onEnded → app/game.tsx:8 router.replace; called from RemoteGameHost.onEvents → emit (remoteGameHost.ts:537-566), itself run from room.onMessage (remoteGameHost.ts:457-458). Server sends 'solution' as a separate frame right after the events (GameRoom.ts:602,609) → remoteGameHost.ts:498-504 emits again into the screen mid-transition. The practice path was fixed only for its dialog (commit 97b16d6, botPracticeEnd.e2e.test.tsx:36).

rootCauses.cause: A finished room vanishes before an away player can read the result. At gameOver autoDispose=true disposes the room 1 s after the last client is gone and the last reservation lapsed. A drop in phase 'over' gives up the seat with no reservation. A player away at the end (screen off → AppState background → disconnect; or a drop) and back after grace+1 s finds no room: reconnect 'tokenExpired', then the join by code fails with 'notFound'/'roomGone' (FATAL), and the host shuts down with 'lostConnection' and a stale running/paused state. The result is the connection-error screen, or an invisible one if its Reanimated enter never runs after resume, instead of the result the server holds. Moshe's 'keep the screen on' item makes this path easy to hit.
rootCauses.evidence: apps/server/src/rooms/GameRoom.ts:610-611 (autoDispose = true at gameOver), 344-347 (onDrop in 'over': seat.sessionId = null, no allowReconnection), 355-360 (reservation = grace+1 s only), 621-624 (closeAfterGameMs ceiling 60 s, GAME_ROOM_DEFAULTS 177-183); Colyseus node_modules/@colyseus/core/build/Room.mjs:225-240 (autoDispose setter → resetAutoDisposeTimeout(1)), 1351-1357 (_disposeIfEmpty: no clients, no reserved seats), 1209-1221 (lapsed reservation → resetAutoDisposeTimeout). Client: remoteGameHost.ts:814-828 (background = disconnect while not over), 198-206 (notFound/roomGone FATAL), 713 (shutdown lostConnection); connectionModel.ts step 2 → full-screen ConnectionError (ConnectionError.tsx:49,74 opacity enter).
rootCauses.confidence: high that the gap exists; medium as a cause of what Moshe saw

rootCauses.cause: No signal that the end is stored. Ratings, history and match.over() are written in the background after gameOver, but the room never tells the client. refreshMe() on leaving the results can read the old rating, a quick 'משחק חדש' (new game) is refused 'alreadyQueued' until the write is done, and a replay right away gets 409. This is not a black screen, but it is the same contract and the cause of the 'rating does not update' item.
rootCauses.evidence: GameRoom.ts:606-607 (recorder.done → match.over, client not told); persistence/recorder.ts end() (background transaction, retries 500 ms ×2^n, 5 tries); matchmaking/service.ts:243-244 (alreadyQueued while playing); app/results/[id].tsx:28-32 (refreshMe on leave only); the server's own fake client polls GET /v1/me for it (src/testing/fakeClient/client.ts:771-800 readStoredRating).
rootCauses.confidence: high (for the rating symptom); low for the black screen

rootCauses.cause: After the end, a silent socket or a gap still runs the reconnect loop against a finished, possibly disposed room (token, then code, then FATAL → shutdown('lostConnection')). Harmless while the results are up, because connectionModel shows nothing for an over view, but it adds network work and status churn during and after the transition.
rootCauses.evidence: remoteGameHost.ts:603-606 (silence → dropConnection), 634-642 (gap → dropConnection), 664-670 (dropConnection → lose('drop') with no 'over' check); only onLeave (572) and onAppState (817) treat an over game specially.

rootCauses.cause: Unobservable failure. In release builds the host's log lines are dropped. A JS-thread hang, or a native transition stuck at alpha 0, during the replace leaves a blank #0f1218 screen with no Crashlytics report. Breadcrumbs exist ('opening the results', 'results: loading') but are sent only with a crash or non-fatal. This explains why Firebase shows nothing; it does not explain what happened.
rootCauses.evidence: apps/mobile/src/net/device.ts:31-33 (log only in __DEV__); services/crashlytics.ts (log() only travels with a report); GameScreen.tsx:258,544 and ResultsScreen.tsx:77-79 breadcrumbs; theme bg #0f1218 (tokens.generated.ts:18).

design:
## 0. What the server does today at the end (verified, for the implementer)
- Surrender (2 players): onClientMessage → ServerGame.act → onUpdate → recorder.push → onGameUpdate. It broadcasts `events` [cellReleased?, playerSurrendered, gameOver(lastPlayerStanding, ranking, ratingChanges, awards)] (GameRoom.ts:602), sets phase 'over', chains recorder.done.then(match.over) (606-607), broadcasts `solution` (609), sets autoDispose = true (611), and arms closeTimer = closeAfterGameMs (60 s) → disconnect(4000).
- Opponent killed the app: onDrop → engine disconnect (2p: gamePaused), allowReconnection(grace+1 s). When the grace timer fires: playerAbandoned + gameOver, then the same steps as above.
- Consented leave: onLeave → engine disconnect → same.
- Client: RemoteGameHost.onLeave with an over state → shutdown('gameOver'). connectionStatusOf maps that to 'online'. connectionModel shows opponentLeft or nothing.
- Results: read from the store's OnlineSession (app/results/[id].tsx:15-22), with no HTTP call. The ids are one UUID end to end: GameRoom.startGame randomUUID → config.id → view.gameId → games.id.
- Unknown server message types only console.warn in SDK 0.18.5 (sdk/build/Room.mjs:571), so an additive message is safe for old APKs.

## 1. Server: a finished room waits until every player has the end (GameRoom.ts)
New fields:
- `private readonly sawEnd = new Set<PlayerId>()`: players who were sent the end while connected, or got it on return.
- `private closeAt: number | null = null`.
- Helper `private everyoneSawEnd(): boolean { return this.seats.every((s) => this.sawEnd.has(s.playerId)); }`.

onGameUpdate, on reaching 'over', after the `solution` broadcast:
- For each seat whose sessionId is among `this.clients` (NOT just sessionId !== null: a dropped seat keeps its sessionId during its reservation but is not in clients), add the player to sawEnd.
- `this.closeAt = this.deps.now() + this.deps.closeAfterGameMs`.
- Replace `this.autoDispose = true` with `this.autoDispose = this.everyoneSawEnd()`.
- Keep closeTimer as the hard ceiling.

welcomeBack, when phase === 'over': after the snapshot and solution (and `stored`, see §2), `this.sawEnd.add(seat.playerId); this.autoDispose = this.everyoneSawEnd();`. The setter re-arms Colyseus' 1 s auto-dispose check.

onDrop, when phase === 'over': replace `seat.sessionId = null; return;` with: keep seat.sessionId (onReconnect finds the seat by session), set `seat.away = true`, and call `this.allowReconnection(client, Math.max(1, ((this.closeAt ?? now) - now) / 1000)).catch(() => undefined)`. When that reservation lapses, Colyseus calls onLeave (isDrop) and the existing code nulls the seat. disconnect() at closeAt rejects any pending reservation.

onReconnect: unchanged (it already clears away and calls welcomeBack).

Effect:
- Normal case (everyone connected at the end, then everyone leaves): unchanged, the room closes about 1 s later.
- A player away at the end, or one who drops after it: the room lives until they come back by token or code, or until closeAt (60 s).

Also update the header comment (lines 50-103, step "3. Over").

## 2. Protocol + server: `stored` message (shared with the "rating does not update" item; build it once)
In packages/protocol/src/index.ts, add to ServerMessage:
```ts
/** A rated game's end is stored (spec §19): result, ratings, history written; matchmaking takes its players again.
 * Sent once to everyone in the room after `solution`, and again to a player back in the finished room.
 * ok:false — the end could not be written (ratings did not move). Unrated rooms never send it. */
| { type: 'stored'; gameId: string; ok: boolean }
```
Add 'stored' to SERVER_MESSAGE_TYPES, after 'solution'. PROTOCOL_VERSION stays 1 (the change is additive).

GameRoom:
- Add `private stored: { gameId: string; ok: boolean } | null = null`.
- In onGameUpdate at over, if this.recorder:
```ts
void this.recorder.done.then((o) => {
  this.stored = { gameId: state.config.id, ok: o.ok };
  if (this.opened) this.broadcastMessage({ type: 'stored', ...this.stored });
});
```
  Chain it as part of, or alongside, the existing match.over() chain.
- welcomeBack phase 'over': `if (this.stored) this.sendTo(client, { type: 'stored', ...this.stored })`.
- Fake client (src/testing/fakeClient/client.ts onMessage switch ~807): add `case 'stored'`. Optionally finish on it instead of polling readStoredRating.

## 3. Client: never open the results from inside the server's message
- apps/mobile/src/screens/game/model.ts: add `export const ONLINE_END_HOLD_MS = 600` with a doc comment: an online game's end (surrender, abandonment) holds the board this long before the results, so the end's frames (events, solution) land first and the navigation never runs inside the server's message. Change the signature to `endDelayMs(reason, reduce, online = false)`:
  - boardComplete: unchanged.
  - otherwise: `online ? (reduce ? motion.duration.reducedFade : ONLINE_END_HOLD_MS) : 0`.
- GameScreen.tsx 'ended' case (739-749): `showResults(e.gameId, endDelayMs(reason, reduce, isOnline))`. showResults then always goes through `later()` online, because delay > 0 → waits > 0.
- Unchanged: the dialog wait (dialogUp/onExited/DIALOG_GONE_CEILING_MS); the practice path (delay 0, as fixed for bug 9); 'לתוצאות' (a press); the mount-time over effect (944-947, runs in an effect, not the socket callback).
- The hold respects Reduced Motion (200 ms).

## 4. Client: an over game never reconnects (remoteGameHost.ts)
- In dropConnection(): if `this.state?.status === 'over'`, then `const room = this.room; this.goOffline(); void room?.leave(true).catch(() => undefined); return this.shutdown('gameOver', null);`. This covers the silence path (603-606) and the gap timer (640).
- onLeave already returns shutdown('gameOver') for an over state.
- New `case 'stored'`: `this.stored = { gameId: m.gameId, ok: m.ok }; this.notifyOnline();`. Ignore it if `this.state?.config.id !== m.gameId`.
- Add `stored?: { ok: boolean } | null` to OnlineInfo (optional, like startsAt, so the fakes keep compiling) and fill it in makeInfo.
- Update the header doc.

## 5. Client: diagnostics, so the next black screen leaves a trace
- net/device.ts: `log: (line) => { if (__DEV__) console.log(`[online] ${line}`); else crashReporter().log(`online: ${line}`); }`. Breadcrumbs only, never sent alone. The token is never in a line (documented in RemoteGameHost).
- app/game.tsx, results watchdog: keep `const resultsTimer = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null)`. The route's onEnded becomes:
```ts
(id) => {
  crashReporter().log(`game route: results ${id}`);
  openResults(id);
  resultsTimer.current = setTimeout(() => {
    crashReporter().log('game route: results did not open');
    crashReporter().recordError(new Error('results did not open'), 'game end');
    openResults(id);
  }, RESULTS_WATCHDOG_MS);
}
```
  The existing unmount cleanup clears the timer. Export `RESULTS_WATCHDOG_MS = 3000` from screens/game/model.ts. Wrap the callback body in try/catch: a throw out of a timer is fatal in release.
- Also log `game route: nothing to show (leaving=…)` when GameRoute returns null (app/game.tsx:65).
- app/results/[id].tsx: `crashReporter().log(`results route: ${id} ${online?.id === id ? 'online' : 'practice'}`)` once on mount.

## 6. Client: consuming `stored` (owned together with the rating item)
- OnlineSession: `get stored()` from host.online, plus an `onStored` dep called once when ok becomes true.
- gameStore: pass `deps.onRankedStored ?? (() => void refreshMe())` into the OnlineSession built in goRanked/goOnline. The default calls refreshMe; inject it to keep the store test-pure.
- The results route keeps refreshMe() on leave as the fallback. That covers old servers, and a room closed before the write finished.

## 7. Optional, needs a decision: results from the server when the room is gone
When the host closes with 'lostConnection' and error code notFound or roomGone, while holding a ranked game that is not over, the ConnectionError offers "לתוצאות" (to results). That button:
- calls GET /v1/games/:id/replay (retrying 409 notFinished every 1 s, up to 10 times);
- evolves the events from gameCreated into the final GameState;
- shows the results through a new `loadRankedResults(id, api)` in resultsModel.ts.

It needs new i18n keys (he+en), e.g. `game:connection.error.toResults`, `game:results.fetching`. It is not needed for the black screen.

## Config values
- ONLINE_END_HOLD_MS = 600 (reduced motion: motion.duration.reducedFade = 200).
- RESULTS_WATCHDOG_MS = 3000.
- GAME_ROOM_DEFAULTS.closeAfterGameMs = 60_000, unchanged: now the ceiling for an away player, no longer reached only when someone stays connected.
- Rules and engine: no change.

## Edge cases
- 3–4 players: a surrendered player who stays sees the end; one who left is 'away' and keeps the room up to 60 s (acceptable).
- A rejoin by code to an over room (onJoin → welcomeBack) adds the player to sawEnd and may let the room dispose 1 s after they leave.
- A match room cancelled before GO (onMatchCancel) has no game: untouched.
- A server restart cuts a game (serverRestart): untouched.
- Old APK + new server: 'stored' is only warned about in the console.
- New APK + old server: no 'stored' → refreshMe on leave as today.
- A rejected surrender while offline: unchanged.

risks: The leading cause (navigation inside the WebSocket callback) is a correlation and was not reproduced on a device. The fix is cheap and preventive, and the watchdog plus the Crashlytics breadcrumbs will show the failing step if the black screen comes back. A pure JS-thread hang would still not be reported.

These files are also edited by the 'grace without communication' item (remoteGameHost silence/reconnect logic, GameRoom onDrop/onLeave) and the rating items (gameOver ratingChanges, refreshMe, 'stored'). Merge in one order and keep §1 and §4 compatible with the new offline grace.
Rooms may now linger up to closeAfterGameMs (60 s) after a non-consented drop following the end. This is bounded and small.

Server deploy and APK skew: the server must be deployed for the room-lifetime fix and 'stored'. Old APKs only console.warn on 'stored'. A new APK on an old server gets no 'stored' and falls back to refreshMe on leave.

Test timing churn: tests that expected onEnded synchronously on an online end (GameScreenOnline surrender, gameRoute online end, ranked e2e) must advance the hold. Practice timing is deliberately unchanged, to avoid re-breaking the bug-9 tests.
The watchdog may call openResults twice if the first replace was only slow (more than 3 s). expo-router's replace to the same route is idempotent enough, but log it.
Item 1 (keep the screen on) reduces the background-at-the-end path. Without it, the 60 s room window is the only protection.

decisions.question: כמה זמן להשאיר את הלוח אחרי כניעה או נטישה במשחק אונליין, לפני מעבר אוטומטי לתוצאות?
decisions.recommendedDefault: 0.6 שניות (0.2 שניות עם הפחתת תנועה), כהגדרה ONLINE_END_HOLD_MS. אימון נשאר כמו היום.

decisions.question: כמה זמן חדר של משחק שהסתיים מחכה לשחקן שלא היה מחובר ברגע הסיום (מסך כבוי, רקע)?
decisions.recommendedDefault: 60 שניות, closeAfterGameMs הקיים. רק כשמישהו לא קיבל את הסיום; אחרת החדר נסגר מיד כמו היום.

decisions.question: שחקן שחוזר אחרי שהחדר כבר נסגר: להביא את התוצאה מההיסטוריה בשרת עכשיו, או בשלב אחר?
decisions.recommendedDefault: בשלב אחר. עכשיו נשאר מסך שגיאת החיבור הקיים. זה דורש מחרוזות חדשות ומסך טעינה, ולא קשור למסך השחור.

decisions.question: הודעת שרת חדשה 'stored' (התוצאה והדירוג נשמרו): לבנות אותה כאן, יחד עם הבאג של הדירוג שלא מתעדכן?
decisions.recommendedDefault: כן, פעם אחת ומשותפת לשני הסעיפים. השרת בסעיף הזה, ורענון הדירוג באפליקציה בסעיף הדירוג.

decisions.question: לשלוח את לוג החיבור של המשחק כ־breadcrumbs ל־Crashlytics בגרסת release (בלי טוקנים), כדי לאבחן מסך שחור הבא?
